entries.title: Psalms 38:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David. To bring to remembrance.>> O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your wrath, Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure!

entries.title: Psalms 38:2
segments: For Your arrows pierce me deeply, And Your hand presses me down.

entries.title: Psalms 38:3
segments: [There is] no soundness in my flesh Because of Your anger, Nor [any] health in my bones Because of my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:4
segments: For my iniquities have gone over my head; Like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:5
segments: My wounds are foul [and] festering Because of my foolishness.

entries.title: Psalms 38:6
segments: I am troubled, I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 38:7
segments: For my loins are full of inflammation, And [there is] no soundness in my flesh.

entries.title: Psalms 38:8
segments: I am feeble and severely broken; I groan because of the turmoil of my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 38:9
segments: Lord, all my desire [is] before You; And my sighing is not hidden from You.

entries.title: Psalms 38:10
segments: My heart pants, my strength fails me; As for the light of my eyes, it also has gone from me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:11
segments: My loved ones and my friends stand aloof from my plague, And my relatives stand afar off.

entries.title: Psalms 38:12
segments: ¶Those also who seek my life lay snares [for me]; Those who seek my hurt speak of destruction, And plan deception all the day long.

entries.title: Psalms 38:13
segments: But I, like a deaf [man], do not hear; And [I am] like a mute [who] does not open his mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 38:14
segments: Thus I am like a man who does not hear, And in whose mouth [is] no response.

entries.title: Psalms 38:15
segments: For in You, O LORD, I hope; You will hear, O Lord my God.

entries.title: Psalms 38:16
segments: For I said, "[Hear me], lest they rejoice over me, Lest, when my foot slips, they exalt [themselves] against me."

entries.title: Psalms 38:17
segments: For I [am] ready to fall, And my sorrow [is] continually before me.

entries.title: Psalms 38:18
segments: For I will declare my iniquity; I will be in anguish over my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 38:19
segments: But my enemies [are] vigorous, [and] they are strong; And those who hate me wrongfully have multiplied.

entries.title: Psalms 38:20
segments: Those also who render evil for good, They are my adversaries, because I follow [what is] good.

entries.title: Psalms 38:21
segments: Do not forsake me, O LORD; O my God, be not far from me!

entries.title: Psalms 38:22
segments: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!
